reader.requirement: At --std 85 the compiler must accept the SUPPRESS statement written as SUPPRESS with the optional word PRINTING (PDF page 652: SUPPRESS underlined, PRINTING not), and refuse any other form (an operand, a group name); the placement rule SR1 (only in a USE BEFORE REPORTING procedure) is the format's companion rule.

edition-consulted.switches: whether SUPPRESS is reserved at the edition; true for 1985, 2002, 2014 and 2023
BoundRejected.Report(ctx.Edition, COBOL1581) resolves the SR1 refusal's severity through the edition; EditionSeverity.Error at every edition

DialectLevel < 2002 checks every statement of a 1985 USE BEFORE REPORTING procedure for references to control data (§1985:XIII.3.20.3 SR5); SUPPRESS writes no reference so the 85 arm is inert for this statement

reader.edition-search: grep -i suppress over src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Editions (no ConstructRegistry row for the statement; only copy-suppress-2002 and alternate-key-suppress-when-2023, which are other constructs), grep Edition|DialectLevel in ReportWriterBinder.cs, grammar has no version predicate on suppressStatement
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the format SUPPRESS [PRINTING] is the same at 1985 and 2023 and the grammar and binder take one path
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness writes SUPPRESS PRINTING in a USE BEFORE REPORTING procedure; the bare SUPPRESS (PRINTING omitted) and the refusals of an operand are not exercised

probes.expected: SUPPRESS PRINTING accepted; detail 2 not presented

probes.printed: exit 0, MATCH of the same output

reader.notes: The format itself (§1985:XIII.4.6.2) has only two words, too short for cite.py's quotation check; the rendered PDF page 652 shows SUPPRESS underlined and PRINTING not, matching the grammar's SUPPRESS PRINTING?. Classes a, c-f do not apply to an operandless statement; 2023's format is the same, so there is no later phrase to refuse.

refuter.evidence: Read ReportWriterBinder.BindSuppress: SR1 resolved by ctx.Enclosing.Declarative?.ReportGroup (lexical containment, no edition arm). Probes at --std 85: refute-1985-086/src/sp_err.cob (SUPPRESS PRINTING in a USE AFTER STANDARD ERROR declarative) -> error COBOL1581, refused as SR1 requires; src/sp_para2.cob (bare SUPPRESS in the SECOND paragraph of a USE BEFORE REPORTING section, reached by GO TO) -> exit 0, 'N 1 LC 00 / N 2 LC 01 / N 3 LC 02': the group is suppressed and LINE-COUNTER not advanced. LINE SEQUENTIAL refused at 85 (COBOL0900), an incidental edition gate. cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.4.6.3 SR1 'may only appear in a USE BEFORE REPORTING procedure'; OK §1985:XIII.4.6.4 GR1 'inhibits presentation only for the report group named in the USE procedure'. Optional-word convention: line 6563 of the 1985 text (uppercase not underlined = optional). The format is the same at 2023; no later phrase to refuse.
